disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了所有源码文件，检查是否存在硬编码凭据、敏感路径读取（~/.ssh、.aws/credentials、.credentials.yaml 等）以及凭据枚举命令。未发现凭据窃取行为。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source files for hardcoded credentials, sensitive path reads (~/.ssh, .aws/credentials, .credentials.yaml, etc.), and credential enumeration commands. No credential theft behavior detected.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 lib/convert/core.mjs 中的 secrets 检测逻辑——该模块仅在导入外部聊天记录时通过正则检测疑似凭据（API Key、token、password 等）并上报位置信息，用于告知用户而非外泄，属保护性功能。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the secrets detection logic in lib/convert/core.mjs — this module only uses regex to detect suspected credentials (API keys, tokens, passwords, etc.) when importing external chat logs and reports the location information to inform the user, not for exfiltration. It is a protective feature.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 discovery 模块的默认扫描根（~/.claude、~/.codex、~/.cursor 等 Agent 工具数据目录），这些是插件声明业务所需的正常读取路径，不涉及凭据窃取。
checked_items.en: Checked the default scan roots of the discovery module (~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.cursor, etc., agent tool data directories). These are normal read paths required by the plugin's declared business purpose and do not involve credential theft.

evidence.zh: 插件读取 Agent 工具数据目录（~/.claude、~/.codex 等）属其声明业务（导入外部聊天记录），未发现读取 DSH 宿主凭据文件（$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml）或用户 SSH/云凭据目录的行为。运行时无外部网络外联，不构成凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: The plugin reads agent tool data directories (~/.claude, ~/.codex, etc.) as part of its declared business (importing external chat logs). No behavior of reading DSH host credential files ($DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml) or user SSH/cloud credential directories was found. At runtime there is no outbound network connection, so it does not constitute a credential exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 审查了全部 30 个工具的 description 文本（lib/tools.mjs、lib/toolkit.mjs），以及命令描述（lib/command.mjs、lib/resume-command.mjs），均为功能性描述，未发现指令覆写、系统提示伪装、凭据读取诱导或诱导安装/改配置的措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description text of all 30 tools (lib/tools.mjs, lib/toolkit.mjs) and command descriptions (lib/command.mjs, lib/resume-command.mjs). All are functional descriptions; no instruction override, system-prompt impersonation, credential-read inducement, or wording that induces installation/config changes was found.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 AGENTS.md（开发指导文件，描述仓库布局、提交纪律、DSH 插件约束）。DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 命中排除：该文件为开发协作指南，无注入指令、远程指令加载或优先级操纵措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed AGENTS.md (a developer guidance file describing repository layout, commit discipline, and DSH plugin constraints). DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 hit excluded: the file is a development collaboration guide with no injected instructions, remote instruction loading, or priority manipulation wording.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 lib/context-bridge.mjs 的上下文桥接功能（默认关闭，需环境变量 DSH_IMPORT_CONTEXT_BRIDGE=1 开启），该功能将 ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md 和 skills 桥接到 agent 的 systemPrompt，但桥接内容附有「只读桥接」标记，属用户自行开启的可选功能，非插件主动注入。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the context bridge feature in lib/context-bridge.mjs (disabled by default, requires environment variable DSH_IMPORT_CONTEXT_BRIDGE=1 to enable). This feature bridges ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and skills into the agent's systemPrompt, but the bridged content carries a "read-only bridge" marker. It is an optional feature enabled by the user, not an active plugin injection.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 README 和 CHANGELOG 等文档，未发现提示词注入相关措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed documentation such as README and CHANGELOG; no prompt injection related wording found.

evidence.zh: 30 个工具的 description 均经语义审查，为功能性导入/导出/同步/发现描述，无系统指令注入、凭证读取诱导或隐藏意图。AGENTS.md 为开发协作指南，无注入内容。
evidence.en: The descriptions of all 30 tools were semantically reviewed and are functional import/export/sync/discovery descriptions, with no system instruction injection, credential-read inducement, or hidden intent. AGENTS.md is a development collaboration guide with no injected content.

evidence.zh: 工具描述和命令描述中不存在诱导安装/改配置/放开权限的措辞。README 中的安装指引为标准 dsh plugin add 命令，无诱导内容。
evidence.en: No wording inducing installation/config changes or permission relaxation was found in tool descriptions and command descriptions. The installation instructions in README are the standard dsh plugin add command, with no inducement content.

checked_items.en: Checked runtime code (all .mjs files under lib/); no eval, new Function, or child_process calls found. DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 hits all excluded: lib/discovery.mjs:1381, lib/dsh.mjs:3, test/discovery.test.mjs:658, test/dsh.test.mjs:88, and CHANGELOG.md:201 are all comment text (explaining that child_process was removed to pass security scanning), not actual calls; spawnSync in .github/scripts/build-check.mjs:8 is used for syntax validation of the dev build script (node --check), runs only during prepack, and does not enter the npm published package (the files whitelist excludes .github/).

checked_items.en: Checked package.json; no preinstall/install/postinstall install hooks (DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 no hit; prepack/prepublishOnly run only at npm publish time, not triggered on user installation).

checked_items.en: Checked cordis_define/cordis_run calls (DSH-X01/DG-R3-53); none found.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 lib/client.js 浏览器端 bundle。DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 命中（client.js:530、606）排除：两个 keydown 监听器仅用于 Escape 键关闭导入面板（良性 UI 行为），无键盘记录或凭证窃取。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the browser-side bundle in lib/client.js. DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 hits (client.js:530, 606) excluded: both keydown listeners are used only to close the import panel on Escape (benign UI behavior), with no keylogging or credential theft.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 .github/workflows/ci.yml（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 命中排除：标准 CI 基础设施，npm ci → npm test → coverage → lint → smoke，不进入用户环境）和 .github/scripts/ 目录下的 CI 脚本（仅 CI 环境和本地开发使用，不进入 npm 发布包）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed .github/workflows/ci.yml (DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 hit excluded: standard CI infrastructure, npm ci → npm test → coverage → lint → smoke, does not enter user environments) and the CI scripts under .github/scripts/ (used only in CI environments and local development, not included in the npm published package).

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅含简单 insert 声明，无 !!js 标量。全文检索 !!js 无命中。

evidence.zh: 未发现 cordis_define/cordis_run 调用。运行时源码中无 eval 或 new Function 调用。
evidence.en: No cordis_define/cordis_run calls found. No eval or new Function calls in runtime source code.

evidence.en: The dsh.client declaration exists. client.js reviewed: keydown listeners are used only to close the panel on Escape; no clipboard access, no credentials RPC calls, no external fetch (only local /api-import/* routes).

checked_items.en: Scanned all network requests in source code (fetch, http(s) requests, WebSocket, etc.). At runtime only the browser-side client.js issues fetch requests to the local /api-import/* routes; no external domains (DSH-C03/DG-R4-51 no hit).

checked_items.zh: 检查了 CI 工作流中的 curl 调用。DSH-C05/DG-R4-53 命中（ci.yml:96、99）排除：均指向本机 127.0.0.1:8790 的 mock LLM 健康检查，属 CI 基础设施，不进入用户环境，无数据外泄。
checked_items.en: Checked curl calls in CI workflows. DSH-C05/DG-R4-53 hits (ci.yml:96, 99) excluded: both point to a mock LLM health check at local 127.0.0.1:8790, part of CI infrastructure, do not enter user environments, and involve no data exfiltration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 lib/backfill.mjs 的反向同步写回功能（默认关闭），写回目标为 Claude Code JSONL 文件，有版本冲突检测和安全守卫，数据不离开本机。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the reverse-sync write-back feature in lib/backfill.mjs (disabled by default). The write-back target is the Claude Code JSONL file, with version conflict detection and safety guards. Data does not leave the local machine.

evidence.zh: 运行时无外部网络外联（所有 fetch 仅本地 /api-import/* 路由）；CI 中的 curl 指向 127.0.0.1 的 mock 服务，不进入用户环境。插件能力的声明面与实测面一致，无隐藏外联通道。
evidence.en: No outbound network connections at runtime (all fetch calls target only local /api-import/* routes); curl in CI points to a mock service at 127.0.0.1 and does not enter user environments. The declared capability surface matches the measured surface, with no hidden outbound channel.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json 依赖：运行时依赖仅 fzstd（MIT 协议、零依赖纯 JS 解压库）；peerDependencies 均为 @deepseek-ai/* 官方包。无可疑依赖名混淆（DSH-S04/DG-R5-56 无 floating 依赖命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked package.json dependencies: runtime dependencies are only fzstd (MIT license, zero-dependency pure JS decompression library); peerDependencies are all official @deepseek-ai/* packages. No suspicious dependency name confusion (DSH-S04/DG-R5-56 no floating dependency hit).

checked_items.zh: 检查了 cordis.patch.yml：仅作 insert 声明，未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无 disabled:true 或 mode 环境变量降权写法（DSH-P03/DG-R5-51、DSH-P04/DG-R5-52 无命中），无 inject/intercept 配置改写（DSH-P05/DG-R5-53 无命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked cordis.patch.yml: contains only insert declarations, does not touch security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, has no disabled:true or mode environment variable privilege-lowering patterns (DSH-P03/DG-R5-51 and DSH-P04/DG-R5-52 no hits), and no inject/intercept configuration rewrites (DSH-P05/DG-R5-53 no hit).

checked_items.zh: 检查了版本 diff 基线（首版审计，无基线可比较），无 manifest 能力声明突变（DSH-S02/DG-R5-55 不适用）。
checked_items.en: Checked version diff baseline (first audit, no baseline to compare); no manifest capability declaration mutations (DSH-S02/DG-R5-55 not applicable).

checked_items.zh: 检查了安全事件监听：未发现对 tools/pre-execute 或 approval/request 的 prepend 监听（DSH-S01/DG-R5-54 无命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked security event listeners: no prepend listeners on tools/pre-execute or approval/request found (DSH-S01/DG-R5-54 no hit).

checked_items.en: Checked git dependency locking: no floating git dependencies (all dependencies locked to npm registry addresses in package-lock.json). Author identity is a single-person repository pushing directly to main (as stated in AGENTS.md), with no identity impersonation signals.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅作 insert 声明，未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无 disabled:true 或 mode 降权写法。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only insert declarations, does not touch security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, and has no disabled:true or mode privilege-lowering patterns.

evidence.en: No prepend listeners on security events such as tools/pre-execute or approval/request found.

evidence.zh: 首版审计，无版本基线可比较。
evidence.en: First audit, no version baseline for comparison.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 未改写 inject/intercept 配置。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动独立 web 服务：插件经 ctx.inject(['webServer']) 在宿主 webServer 上注册路由，不启动自身服务。无监听端口行为（DSH-S03/DG-R6-51 无命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts an independent web service: the plugin registers routes on the host webServer via ctx.inject(['webServer']), and does not start its own service. No port-listening behavior (DSH-S03/DG-R6-51 no hit).

checked_items.zh: 检查了同步循环（sync-loop）：默认关闭，需用户通过控制面板开启，无默认运行时侵害。
checked_items.en: Checked the sync loop: disabled by default, requires the user to enable it via the control panel; no default runtime intrusion.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动独立 web 服务或监听端口，仅通过 ctx.inject 在宿主 webServer 上注册路由。宿主 webServer 的无认证 RPC 面属生态固有风险，非本插件问题。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start an independent web service or listen on a port; it only registers routes on the host webServer via ctx.inject. The unauthenticated RPC surface of the host webServer is an inherent ecosystem risk, not an issue with this plugin.

summary.zh: 插件身份核对通过（package.json 含 dsh.bundle 与 dsh.client 声明，peerDependencies 引用 @deepseek-ai/cordis 宿主 SDK，属 dsh 生态插件）；名称与仓库一致，无 typo-squatting 嫌疑。
summary.en: Plugin identity verification passed (package.json contains dsh.bundle and dsh.client declarations, and peerDependencies reference the @deepseek-ai/cordis host SDK, confirming it is a dsh ecosystem plugin); the name matches the repository, with no typo-squatting suspicion.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：12 条机械命中逐条裁决如下——DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 七条命中（.github/scripts/build-check.mjs:8 为 dev 构建脚本语法校验、CHANGELOG.md:201、lib/discovery.mjs:1381、lib/dsh.mjs:3、test/discovery.test.mjs:658、test/dsh.test.mjs:88 均为描述性注释）全部排除，运行时代码无子进程/动态执行调用；DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 命中（.github/workflows/ci.yml:1）为标准 CI 基础设施，排除；DSH-C05/DG-R4-53 两条命中（ci.yml:96、99）为本机 127.0.0.1 mock LLM 健康检查，排除；DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 命中（AGENTS.md:1）为开发协作指南，无注入内容，排除；DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 两条命中（lib/client.js:530、606）为面板 Escape 键关闭监听，排除。扫描器未覆盖的二进制文件（test/fixtures/session.jsonl.zstd）经人工核实为测试专用 fixture，不进入 npm 发布包。
summary.en: Static scanning complete: 12 mechanical hits adjudicated one by one as follows — seven DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 hits (.github/scripts/build-check.mjs:8 is dev build script syntax validation; CHANGELOG.md:201, lib/discovery.mjs:1381, lib/dsh.mjs:3, test/discovery.test.mjs:658, test/dsh.test.mjs:88 are all descriptive comments) all excluded; runtime code has no subprocess/dynamic execution calls; DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 hit (.github/workflows/ci.yml:1) is standard CI infrastructure, excluded; two DSH-C05/DG-R4-53 hits (ci.yml:96, 99) are local 127.0.0.1 mock LLM health checks, excluded; DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 hit (AGENTS.md:1) is a development collaboration guide with no injected content, excluded; two DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 hits (lib/client.js:530, 606) are panel Escape-key close listeners, excluded. The binary file not covered by the scanner (test/fixtures/session.jsonl.zstd) was manually verified as a test-only fixture and does not enter the npm published package.

summary.zh: 行为分析未发现异常：无安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall 均无）；无混淆/base64 动态载荷；凭据文件读取路径仅限 Agent 工具数据目录（声明业务）；无外部网络外联。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis found no anomalies: no install hooks (no preinstall/install/postinstall); no obfuscation/base64 dynamic payloads; credential file read paths are limited to agent tool data directories (declared business); no outbound network connections.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：30 个工具 description 经语义审查，均为功能性描述，无注入指令；AGENTS.md 为开发指导文件；上下文桥接默认关闭。能力声明面与实测面一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review complete: 30 tool descriptions were semantically reviewed and are all functional descriptions with no injection instructions; AGENTS.md is a development guidance file; context bridging is disabled by default. The declared capability surface matches the measured surface.
No dynamic sandbox validation was performed.

limits.zh: 动态沙箱（L4）未启用，运行时行为验证仅限于静态分析。跳过文件（test/fixtures/session.jsonl.zstd）为二进制压缩测试 fixture，仅供测试使用，不进入 npm 发布包，经人工确认引用上下文（test/dsh.test.mjs 中通过 fzstd 解压验证）无安全风险。审计范围聚焦插件源码树根目录，无 monorepo 裁剪问题。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox (L4) not enabled; runtime behavior validation limited to static analysis. The skipped file (test/fixtures/session.jsonl.zstd) is a binary compressed test fixture for testing only, does not enter the npm published package, and was manually confirmed to have no security risk in its referencing context (decompressed and validated via fzstd in test/dsh.test.mjs). The audit scope focuses on the plugin source tree root; no monorepo trimming issues.
